cockpit.description: {name}, this surface combines user activity, AI usage trends, portal performance, and the actions worth handling first.
cockpit.signalsDesc: Bring agents, knowledge bases, storage, and cost into one side panel for quick review.

signals.agentsDesc: See how many agents are available for tenant operations and publishing.
signals.kbDesc: Confirm how many knowledge bases are ready for retrieval and QA.
signals.storageDesc: Review storage consumption from the portal usage perspective.
signals.costDesc: Track accumulated spend and detect high-consumption periods early.

cockpit.actionsDesc: Jump directly from the cockpit into the most-used resource, analytics, and governance pages.

actions.agentsDesc: Open agent details, configuration, and publishing states.
actions.kbsDesc: Add documents, tune knowledge sources, and verify readiness.
actions.usageDesc: Inspect call volume, costs, and trend shifts.
actions.usersDesc: Open organization and user architecture to review members and roles.
actions.storageDesc: Confirm attachment capacity and file structure health.
actions.logsDesc: Replay recent tenant actions for troubleshooting and operational review.

cockpit.trendDesc: Keep call volume and token consumption in one trend chart to understand the current rhythm of tenant AI usage.
cockpit.portalDesc: Treat document inventory, conversation density, token usage, and active users as the core health metrics of the tenant-facing portal.
cockpit.widgetsDesc: Keep plugin entry points visible while folding tenant-side extension capability into the cockpit layout.
cockpit.widgetsEmptyDesc: No tenant-visible plugin currently registers content to the dashboard_widgets area, so no plugin cards are shown here.
cockpit.summaryDesc: Bring in real attachment, knowledge, and storage structure signals to complete the tenant dashboard context.
cockpit.activitiesDesc: Recent tenant-side operations, useful for quick validation of ongoing actions and entry-point issues.
